title: Choose the catalogue’s visual world
question: The direction roll assigned the Specimen Register. Choose it, take an alternate, choose the familiar catalogue, or re-roll.

options.label: Specimen Register
options.lineage: museum accession registers and specimen labels
options.thesis: Each product is an inspectable record students can edit and instructors can review.
options.viewport: A two-pane registry keeps the searchable product index beside the selected record’s edit form and readable MongoDB document.
options.risk: If the register feels like an archive prop, the CRUD task and document structure lose clarity.

raised.raise: Stock states use a word and a quantity as well as colour, so status stays clear at a glance.
Availability and save feedback stay visible as the selected record changes.
Selecting a record updates its inspector in place while the catalogue stays in view.

options.label: Document Workbench
options.thesis: The catalogue is a working surface for editing records and reading their document shape.
options.viewport: A compact product index sits beside an editor and BSON-style document preview, making the database demonstration direct.
options.risk: It is familiar and may look too much like a generic database console.

options.label: Visible Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The product list and document fields become a clear, visible construction grid.
options.viewport: Product rows align to a strict grid; selecting one reveals its fields and nested specs in a two-column document map.
options.case: Strong on product clarity through alignment; less tied to the student and instructor setting than the register.
options.risk: Every record may feel like a poster instead of an editable product.

options.label: Reference Leaf
options.lineage: tabbed technical manuals with clear reference sections
options.thesis: The catalogue behaves like an open reference manual for product records.
options.viewport: A persistent product index opens into a reference leaf with editable fields and a legible document view, using section tabs to aid wayfinding.
options.case: Strong for the assignment’s explain-and-review scene; slower and more layered for quick edits.
options.risk: The manual metaphor could make a live CRUD surface feel static.

options.label: Action-Only Accent
options.thesis: The catalogue uses plain language and keeps its bright colour on usable actions.
options.viewport: The record list and inspector share one simple workspace, with an easy to reach add action and responsive touch targets.
options.case: Strong for everyday usability; less distinctive and less explicit about MongoDB documents than the register.
options.risk: It may resemble a generic consumer app instead of a technical assignment tool.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.lineage: darkroom exposure records and tracing sheets
options.thesis: A product’s data is treated like measured exposure, layered and annotated.
options.case: Declined: the metaphor is too specialized for everyday catalogue work.
options.kept: Use written stock labels and quantities, never colour alone, to show status clearly.
options.risk: Its exposure vocabulary would obscure product fields.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets and carbon-copy coupons
options.thesis: Each product becomes a paper coupon with its own visible state.
options.case: Declined: a journey and sequence do not match product editing or document inspection.
options.kept: Keep availability and form feedback visible as the selected record changes.
options.risk: The ticket metaphor would imply a sequence the catalogue does not have.

options.label: Single-Item Feed
options.thesis: Each product takes the full screen and advances one at a time.
options.case: Declined: one-item paging fights the need to scan several products and compare stock.
options.kept: Keep the selected record’s inspector in view without hiding the product index.
options.risk: The feed would remove the comparison context the assignment needs.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional CRUD catalogue, executed with exceptional clarity.
canonCard.viewport: A product table, search and category filters, side edit form, and stored JSON preview.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and effective, but indistinguishable from other catalogue dashboards.
